name: get_revenue_quality
description: Fetch the evidence-grade breakdown of an agent's revenue for a period: verified (A/B), supported (C), inferred, claimed, and unresolved totals. Use this whenever the user asks how trustworthy an agent's numbers are.
access_rule: Invoke ONLY when the requester is the agent's operator or an authenticated Zetta admin. For public users, use evidence_coverage from get_agent_snapshot instead and state that grade-level detail is operator-only.
on_error: Return { "error": "<message>", "data_available": false }. Never fabricate a breakdown.
